name: Police Station Lost Property
place: A local police station front desk
speaker: Duty Officer

tasks.goal: Greet the duty officer and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the duty officer and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Report a lost leather wallet lost on public bus line
tasks.hint: Explain what item was lost and where.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported lost wallet and location.

tasks.goal: Describe contents including credit cards and personal ID
tasks.hint: Provide detailed description of lost belongings.
tasks.done_when: Learner described wallet contents and identification.

tasks.goal: Inquire if any matching lost items were handed in today
tasks.hint: Ask officer to check found property registry.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if matching item was turned in.
tasks.scene_hint: Radio static crackles quietly from officer belt as phones ring in background.

tasks.goal: Provide serial number for lost electronic smartphone
tasks.hint: Offer unique identifier numbers for lost device.
tasks.done_when: Learner provided serial number for lost phone.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'affidavit'
tasks.hint: Affidavit means a formal sworn written statement. Ask if an affidavit is required for your claim.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'affidavit'.

tasks.goal: Ask how long unclaimed items are held at station registry
tasks.hint: Inquire about station holding policies.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how long lost property is kept.

tasks.goal: File official lost property report for insurance claim purposes
tasks.hint: Request formal documentation of lost item.
tasks.done_when: Learner filed official lost property report.

tasks.goal: Inquire if nearby transit authority lost-and-found should be contacted
tasks.hint: Ask officer for additional reporting steps.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about transit lost and found contacts.

tasks.goal: Clarify identity verification requirements needed to claim found item
tasks.hint: Ask what ID is needed if item is turned in.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified ID needed to claim property.
tasks.scene_hint: Heavy wooden counter divides public lobby from busy station workspace.

tasks.goal: Ask if photo of lost item can be attached to report
tasks.hint: Inquire about submitting visual proof of lost item.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about attaching photo to lost property report.

tasks.goal: Confirm case reference number for follow-up status inquiries
tasks.hint: Obtain official report reference number.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed case reference number.

tasks.goal: Request official stamped copy of police lost item report
tasks.hint: Ask for paper copy of filed report.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested stamped police report copy.

tasks.goal: Verify phone contact details in case item is recovered later
tasks.hint: Ensure station has correct contact info.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified contact details for future notifications.

tasks.goal: Thank the duty officer and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the duty officer AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Ask for the designated counter for lost and found inquiries
tasks.hint: Ask where lost property inquiries are handled.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for designated lost and found counter.
tasks.scene_hint: A glass-enclosed reception booth overlooks the police station lobby.

tasks.goal: State that you lost a leather briefcase on a city bus
tasks.hint: Explain that a leather briefcase was left on a public bus.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated losing a leather briefcase on a bus.

tasks.goal: Present your photo ID to open a missing item inquiry
tasks.hint: Show your identification to start a lost item search.
tasks.done_when: Learner presented photo ID to open inquiry.

tasks.goal: Describe the color, brand, and distinctive markings of your lost bag
tasks.hint: Provide detailed physical description of the missing bag.
tasks.done_when: Learner described color, brand, and markings of lost bag.

tasks.goal: Mention that a set of house keys was inside the lost briefcase
tasks.hint: Inform officer of keys stored inside the bag.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned house keys were in the briefcase.
tasks.scene_hint: Telephones ring intermittently across busy desks behind the partition.

tasks.goal: Inquire about the standard procedure for filing a formal lost item report
tasks.hint: Ask how lost item reports are processed.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about formal lost item reporting procedures.

tasks.goal: Ask if any lost items turned in today match your description
tasks.hint: Inquire whether matching items were turned in today.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if turned in items match description.

tasks.goal: Specify the exact bus line number and estimated time of loss
tasks.hint: Provide route number and timeframe of loss.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified bus line and estimated time of loss.

tasks.goal: Report a lost laptop computer containing sensitive work documents
tasks.hint: Inform officer about a lost work laptop.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported a lost laptop with work documents.
tasks.scene_hint: Bulletin boards display public safety notices and lost item guidelines.

tasks.goal: Provide the unique serial number of your missing electronic tablet
tasks.hint: Give the tablet serial number for verification.
tasks.done_when: Learner provided serial number for missing tablet.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'serial'
tasks.hint: Serial refers to a unique device identification number. Provide the serial number of your missing item.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'serial'.

tasks.goal: Ask if lost items are cataloged in a centralized digital database
tasks.hint: Inquire if all station lost property is logged electronically.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if lost items are in a digital database.

tasks.goal: Ask how long lost items remain stored in the police property room
tasks.hint: Inquire about holding periods for unclaimed property.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about property room holding duration.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether found credit cards are automatically destroyed for security
tasks.hint: Ask how found payment cards are handled.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if found credit cards are destroyed.
tasks.scene_hint: An officer reviews printed case logs behind the reinforced counter.

tasks.goal: Request a copy of the incident log number for your insurance provider
tasks.hint: Ask for the incident file number for insurance claims.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested incident log number for insurance.

tasks.goal: Ask if someone else can pick up a found item on your behalf
tasks.hint: Inquire about proxy pickup authorization.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if a representative can pick up found item.

tasks.goal: Describe a distinctive scratch on the screen of your lost smartphone
tasks.hint: Point out unique screen damage on lost phone.
tasks.done_when: Learner described a scratch on lost smartphone screen.

tasks.goal: Ask if lost passports or official IDs are forwarded to embassy offices
tasks.hint: Inquire about handling found foreign passports.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if lost passports are sent to embassies.
tasks.scene_hint: Fluorescent lights illuminate rows of metal filing cabinets.

tasks.goal: Inquire about the claims process if a lost item is turned in next week
tasks.hint: Ask how you will be notified if item is found later.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about future lost property claims process.

tasks.goal: Ask if security camera footage from the bus stop can be reviewed
tasks.hint: Inquire about checking bus stop surveillance video.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about reviewing security camera footage.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'confiscated'
tasks.hint: Confiscated means officially seized or retained. Ask if unclaimed items are confiscated.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'confiscated'.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether valuable items like jewelry are kept in a secure vault
tasks.hint: Ask how high-value items are stored.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if valuable items are kept in a safe vault.
tasks.scene_hint: Officers in uniform move efficiently between administrative offices.

tasks.goal: Report that your lost wallet contained foreign currency notes
tasks.hint: Specify foreign cash contents inside lost wallet.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported foreign currency notes in lost wallet.

tasks.goal: Ask if lost bicycles found on public streets are brought to this precinct
tasks.hint: Inquire where found bicycles are held.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if found bicycles are brought to precinct.

tasks.goal: Inquire about the office hours for the property clerk department
tasks.hint: Ask when property room clerks are on duty.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about property clerk office hours.

tasks.goal: Request confirmation that your contact details were recorded accurately
tasks.hint: Verify phone number and email on police file.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested confirmation of recorded contact details.
tasks.scene_hint: Heavy double doors lead to secure evidence storage areas.

tasks.goal: Ask if a processing fee is required when filing a lost property report
tasks.hint: Inquire about administrative report filing fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if filing a lost report requires a fee.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether prescription glasses found in parks are turned in here
tasks.hint: Ask about lost medical items like eyeglasses.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if found prescription glasses are turned in.

tasks.goal: Describe a personalized monogram stitched inside your lost coat
tasks.hint: Provide detail on custom initials inside garment.
tasks.done_when: Learner described personalized monogram inside lost coat.

tasks.goal: Ask if you will receive an automated phone notification if item is found
tasks.hint: Inquire about automated alert notifications.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about automated phone notification status.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'verifications'
tasks.hint: Verifications are checks to confirm identity or ownership. Ask what verifications are required for release.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'verifications'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about claiming found items that remain unclaimed after six months
tasks.hint: Ask about policy regarding long-unclaimed property.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about claiming unclaimed items after six months.

tasks.goal: Explain that you need a police report to request replacement car keys
tasks.hint: State that car key replacement requires police report.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained needing police report for key replacement.

tasks.goal: Ask if lost musical instruments are stored separately from general property
tasks.hint: Inquire about storage of large fragile items.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about storage for musical instruments.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether sports equipment found on athletic fields is logged here
tasks.hint: Ask if found sports gear is brought to station.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if found sports equipment is logged.

tasks.goal: Request an official stamped receipt proving you filed a lost report
tasks.hint: Ask for stamped proof of report filing.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested stamped receipt for lost property report.

tasks.goal: Ask if lost items from local train stations are sent to this precinct
tasks.hint: Inquire about coordination with railway police.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if train station lost items come here.
tasks.scene_hint: A digital visitor queue display ticks quietly near the entrance.

tasks.goal: Inquire about filing an updated description if you recall more details
tasks.hint: Ask how to add details to existing report.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about updating lost item description.

tasks.goal: Ask if lost pets or animal collars are handled by this station
tasks.hint: Inquire about lost pet handling procedures.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if lost pets or collars are handled here.

tasks.goal: Request guidance on reporting a lost handbag containing vital medication
tasks.hint: Explain urgency of missing prescription medication.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested guidance on reporting lost medical bag.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'surveillance'
tasks.hint: Surveillance means security camera monitoring. Ask if surveillance footage can help locate your item.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'surveillance'.

tasks.goal: Ask if found luggage from the airport is transferred to city police
tasks.hint: Inquire about airport lost baggage transfer policies.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if airport lost luggage goes to precinct.

tasks.goal: Inquire about lost property policies regarding found cash sums
tasks.hint: Ask how cash found by citizens is managed.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about lost property policies for cash.
tasks.scene_hint: A clipboard with visitor sign-in logs rests on the front desk.

tasks.goal: Request a reference number to quote when calling back tomorrow
tasks.hint: Ask for case tracking number for follow-up call.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested reference number for follow-up.

tasks.goal: Ask if lost electronic devices are wiped of data before public auction
tasks.hint: Inquire about data privacy on auctioned items.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if electronic devices are wiped before auction.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether high-value items require extra verification before release
tasks.hint: Ask about proof of ownership for high-value claims.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about verification for high-value items.

tasks.goal: Ask if a lost item report can be updated online after leaving
tasks.hint: Inquire about online portal updates for lost property.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if lost item report can be updated online.

tasks.goal: Check if the station has a designated lost-and-found public desk on weekends
tasks.hint: Ask about weekend lost property counter service.
tasks.done_when: Learner checked weekend lost-and-found desk availability.

tasks.goal: Review completed report details with the desk officer for accuracy
tasks.hint: Go over recorded report details before signing.
tasks.done_when: Learner reviewed report details with desk officer.
tasks.scene_hint: Keypads secure access doors behind the main service counter.

tasks.goal: Ask for the direct phone extension of the property custodian officer
tasks.hint: Inquire about direct extension for property room.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for property custodian phone extension.

tasks.goal: Request a business card with the desk officer's badge number
tasks.hint: Ask officer for contact card and badge ID.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested business card with badge number.

tasks.goal: Inquire about estimated response time for lost property trace inquiries
tasks.hint: Ask how long property tracing usually takes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about response time for property trace.

tasks.goal: Confirm that your report has been officially registered in the system
tasks.hint: Verify that the lost item report is active.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed report was registered in system.

tasks.goal: Thank the officer for their assistance before departing the station lobby
tasks.hint: Express gratitude to officer before leaving.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked officer for assistance before departing.
tasks.scene_hint: Official station stamps and ink pads rest on the counter ledger.
